newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-STEYN GIVES NORTHERNS NARROW 23-22 WIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-STEYN GIVES NORTHERNS NARROW 23-22 WIN.

text.p: The boot of right-wing Casper Steyn helped Northern Transvaal into sixth place on the Super 12 rugby union table after a 23-22 victory over Canterbury Crusaders at Loftus Versfeld on Saturday.

Steyn was successful with five kicks out of seven and, crucially, landed a long range penalty in the 69th minute, for the Blue Bulls to snatch only their third win in what has proved to be a troubled season.
All Black flyhalf Andrew Mehrtens put his side 3-0 ahead with a penalty kick in the sixth minute and the Crusaders enjoyed the early territorial advantage.
But Northerns flyhalf Boeta Wessels then responded with an excellent try after a rousing passage of play with the Blue Bulls continually recycling posession inside the Canterbury 22.
Northerns skipper Adriaan Richter fed Wessels from the base of a maul and the pivot burst over the line in the 16th minute. Steyn converted to give the home side a 7-3 lead.
Inside centre Johan Schutte then scored Northerns' second try of the match after several phases of attacking play set up by a scything run by left-wing Jacques Olivier, Steyn again converting.
Just three minutes later, Canterbury reduced the deficit with a goal when number eight Steve Surridge powered over from a five-metre scrum.

Right-wing Afato Sooalo was then fortunate to score the Crusaders' second try when he dived over in the corner, although television replays indicated he had been bundled into touch in the tackle by scrumhalf Joost van der Westhuizen.
Another Steyn penalty levelled the scores at 17-17 going into the break but a second try for Sooalo gave the Crusaders a 22-17 lead early in the second period.
However, Steyn converted further penalties in the 62nd and 69th minutes to give the home side their narrow victory.

Northern Transvaal - Graeme Bouwer (Roland de Marigny, 63rd min); Casper Steyn, Andre Snyman, Johan Schutte, Jacques Olivier; Boeta Wessels, Joost van der Westhuizen; Adriaan Richter (captain), Ruben Kruger, Jannie Brooks (Lourens Muller 70th), Wium Bason, Derrick Grobbelaar, Marius Hurter, Henry Tromp, Lourens Campher.

Canterbury - Daryl Lilley; Afato Sooalo, Tabai Matson, Mark Mayerhofler, Paula Bale; Andrew Mehrtens (Leon MacDonald 22nd), Justin Marshall; Steve Surridge, Scott Robertson (Angus Gardiner 67th), Todd Blackadder, Norman Maxwell, Mark Weedon, Con Barell (Kevin Nepia 48th), Matt Sexton (Mark Hammett 44th), Stuart Loe.
